title: beforeSearch hook
body:
What about providing a `beforeSearch(helper)` hook that would be responsible one provided for launching the helper.search() method?

It would solve cases like:
- I want to programmatically add filters based on the query: if the query changes, I want to update optional facet filters (cc @olance)
- I want to avoid doing the first search query #4 
- avoid search if chars.length < X #185 #182 
- debounce the searchbox #776 #817 (only issue being you do not know it was triggered by the searchBox, but should be enough)
- Let the developer choose to trigger the search (not sure fully resolved by this proposal) #769 

The naming might not be the best one, other possiblities:
- searchHook
- ??

``` js
instantsearch(appID, apiKey, {
  searchHook: function(helper) {
    // once you define the search hook, it's your responsability to call helper.search, otherwise: no search is done
  }
})
```
